answer_text:
# 🇺🇦 Ukraine — Latest News (June 2026)

Here is a summary of the most recent developments regarding Ukraine:

---

## ⚔️ Battlefield Situation

- Ukraine's ability to impede the flow of Russian supplies and personnel to the front lines has grown in recent days, from the southern regions of Zaporizhia and Kherson to the eastern front, forcing the Russian army to a standstill, according to battlefield analysis.

- Ukraine has continued to strike refineries and munitions factories deep inside Russia, weakening its war effort.

- Russia's performance since December shows it can contest territory but cannot hold it, according to battlefield observers.

- General Oleksandr Komarenko, head of the Main Operative Department at the General Staff of the Ukrainian Armed Forces, claimed that Ukrainian forces had restored control over 285.6 km² in the Oleksandrivka direction. In total, Ukrainian forces had cleared 400 km² of territory since the beginning of counteroffensive operations, and February 2026 became the first month since 2024 when Ukraine regained more territory than it lost.

---

## 🚀 Missile & Drone War

- On June 2, Russia fired a cocktail of 656 drones and 73 missiles into Ukrainian civilian areas, killing 23 people and injuring at least 130. Ukraine intercepted 91.7% of the drones and 90.6% of the cruise missiles, but only 27% of the ballistic missiles.

- Russia produces 120 ballistic missiles a month, Zelenskyy told the Ukraine-NATO Council — twice as many as the Patriot interceptors the United States produces.

- Zelenskyy has pledged to produce a Ukrainian version of the Patriot system by the end of 2027.

---

## 🌍 Ukraine's Deep Strike Capabilities

- On May 31, Ukraine's 3rd Army Corps said it had established fire control over the cities of Luhansk, Starobilsk, Alchevsk, Bryanka, and Kadiivka — all 50 to 90 km inside occupied Luhansk — and was able to strike targets up to 205 km away. It was the first time Ukraine declared it had such interdiction power over the eastern region.

- Sensing the growing strength of their position, Ukrainian forces struck the city of St. Petersburg as Russian President Vladimir Putin arrived there for a high-profile economic forum.

---

## 🏛️ Political Developments

- Kyrylo Budanov, head of Ukraine's military intelligence (HUR), was appointed to replace Andriy Yermak as head of the Office of the President of Ukraine.

- President Zelenskyy dismissed Lieutenant General Serhii Deineko as head of the State Border Guard Service of Ukraine, and forced Vasyl Malyuk to resign as head of the SBU.
